name: Fae Mischief
description: Once per battle, when a natural spell roll is one die away from completing a powerful dice pattern, the Fae may change that die after it lands to complete the pattern.
levelUpLine: lvl 47 Passive 🌿 Fae Mischief: Once per battle, when a natural spell roll is one die away from completing a powerful dice pattern, the Fae may change that die after it lands to complete the pattern.
flavor: One of the Fae quietly nudges the die while nobody is looking...
You could have sworn that die landed differently a second ago.
A tiny laugh rings out as fate changes its mind.
The Fae exchange innocent looks. The die does not.
